items.name: cleancode
items.description: Open-source canvas for orchestrating Claude Code, Codex, and other CLI agents. Run agents in parallel, delegate tasks, and let AI build reusable workflows.

items.name: maimai.py
items.description: The definitive python wrapper for MaimaiCN related development. 用于国服舞萌相关开发的最佳Python工具库。

items.name: voltip
items.description: Push-to-talk voice typing for Windows, macOS, Linux and Android. On-device or cloud speech recognition, AI polish with presets, a dictionary, rules and scenes, long recordings with subtitles; the phone works on its own or pairs end-to-end encrypted as the computer's microphone and keyboard.

items.name: KillerScan
items.description: Fast open-source network scanner for field techs. ARP + ping discovery, port probing, active fingerprinting (HTTP, SSH, TLS, NetBIOS, SNMP), and weighted-score device classification in a single portable Windows exe.

items.name: SwarmAI
items.description: A self-evolving Agent OS — every interaction sharpens how it judges, not just what it knows. Four ideas: self-evolution (mistakes become code gates, not logged lessons), brain-first domain brains that grow and decay, cognition that persists between sessions, and proprioception — it senses and drives its own body. Human directs. AI delivers.

items.name: material-painter
items.description: PBR texture painter: paint, bake mesh maps and design materials with a node graph. Rust + wgpu.

items.name: Qurb
items.description: Developing a cross-platform file-sharing application enabling seamless file transfer between desktop and mobile devices across different networks, regardless of geographic distance.

items.name: Voltide
items.description: Battery monitor for 2.4 GHz wireless peripherals
